import networkx as nx
from dimod import MaximumFlow, SimulatedAnnealingSampler, BQM, binary, quadratic, VQE
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, Aer, execute, BasicAerSimulator, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.optimization import QuadraticSampling, Problem
from qiskit.utils import random_bitstring
from scipy.optimize import minimize

def create_qaoa_circuit(graph, p, q):
    n_qubits = len(graph.nodes())
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n_qubits, n_qubits)

    # Initialize state |+⟩^n
    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.h(i)

    # Apply initial Hamiltonian
    for edge, weight in graph.edges(data="weight"):
        i, j = edge
        qc.cx(i, j)
        for _ in range(p):
            qc.cx(i, j)

    # Apply bias Hamiltonian
    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.z(i)
        for _ in range(q):
            qc.z(i)

    return qc

def solve_datacenter_fault_partition(graph_vertices, graph_edges, p=3, q=3):
    graph = nx.Graph()
    graph.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    graph.add_weighted_edges_from(graph_edges)

    n_qubits = len(graph_vertices)
    n_edges = len(graph_edges)

    # Create QAOA circuit
    qc = create_qaoa_circuit(graph, p, q)

    # Initialize problem and optimizer
    bqm = BQM(n_qubits, n_edges)
    for edge, weight in graph.edges(data="weight"):
        i, j = edge
        bqm += quadratic(i, j, 1, 1)
        bqm += quadratic(i, j, -weight, -weight)

    problem = Problem(bqm)
    optimizer = QuadraticSampling(SamplerType.SIMULATED_ANNEALING, penalty=100, initial_temp=10.0, final_temp=1.0)

    # Solve the optimization problem
    result = minimize(lambda x: -problem.objective(x), random_bitstring(len(graph_vertices)), method="SLSQP", args=(optimizer,), options={'maxiter': 1000})

    # Execute the quantum circuit
    qc.bind_parameters(result.x)
    simulator = BasicAerSimulator()
    job = execute(qc, simulator, shots=1000)
    result = job.result()

    # Calculate cut value and other metrics
    counts = result.get_counts(qc)
    cut_value = max(counts[binary(x)] for x in counts if sum(x) > n_edges // 2)
    approximation_ratio = cut_value / (n_edges * n_qubits / 2)
    success_probability = counts[binary(result.x)] / 1000
    circuit_depth = len(qc.data['gate_map'])
    two_qubit_gate_count = qc.count_ops(QuantumCircuit.CCXGate)
    optimizer_calls = result.nit

    return {
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "success_probability": success_probability,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": two_qubit_gate_count,
        "shots": 1000,
        "optimizer_calls": optimizer_calls,
        "cut_value": cut_value
    }
